status: conditional hypotheses, not validated causal findings

mechanism.zh: 固定受众与期限内，供给增加，使每份内容竞争同一注意预算。
mechanism.en: In a fixed audience and horizon, added items compete for the same attention budget.

branch_a.zh: 选择机制不变时，平均单份注意下降。
branch_a.en: With selection unchanged, average attention per item falls.

branch_b.zh: 若新增内容减少搜索浪费，有效理解可以上升。
branch_b.en: If added content reduces wasted search, effective understanding can rise.

test.zh: 测量去重供给、受众时间和理解；若受众扩大或预算改变，固定预算分支失效。
test.en: Measure distinct supply, audience time and comprehension; audience expansion or budget change invalidates the fixed-budget branch.

mechanism.zh: 通知增加且每条触发任务切换，会增加恢复工作所需时间。
mechanism.en: More notifications that each trigger switching increase resumption time.

branch_a.zh: 任务相互干扰时，错误与延迟可能上升。
branch_a.en: Interfering tasks may raise errors and delays.

branch_b.zh: 批量处理或相关信息合并可减少切换，流入增加未必增负。
branch_b.en: Batching or integration can reduce switching despite greater inflow.

test.zh: 比较同量信息的即时与批量投递；若切换和表现均不变，机制受削弱。
test.en: Compare immediate and batched delivery of equal information; unchanged switching and performance weaken the mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 同一任务标准下，把步骤交给工具会改变执行与监督时间。
mechanism.en: At fixed standards, delegation changes execution and supervision time.

branch_a.zh: 净时间节省且由本人支配时，可支配时间增加。
branch_a.en: Net savings under personal control increase discretionary time.

branch_b.zh: 若核验或追加任务吸收节省，休息时间不变或下降。
branch_b.en: Verification or extra assignments can absorb savings and reduce rest.

test.zh: 记录完整时间日记；只有执行变快而总用时未减，不支持自由时间收益。
test.en: Use complete time diaries; faster execution without lower total time does not support free-time gains.

mechanism.zh: 在持续任务压力下，恢复条件可能影响威胁体验和应对能力。
mechanism.en: Under sustained demands, recovery conditions may affect threat experience and coping.

branch_a.zh: 改善恢复后，部分人的焦虑可能下降。
branch_a.en: Better recovery may reduce reported anxiety for some people.

branch_b.zh: 若威胁来自未改变的收入风险，焦虑可能持续。
branch_b.en: Anxiety may persist when unchanged income risks drive it.

test.zh: 追踪恢复、压力来源和焦虑；若只改变恢复而结果不变，应限制该机制的范围。
test.en: Track recovery, stressors and anxiety; no response to changed recovery narrows the mechanism's scope.

mechanism.zh: 高情绪调节要求与恢复条件不足共同作用，可能积累主观疲劳。
mechanism.en: High regulation demands with insufficient recovery may accumulate subjective fatigue.

branch_a.zh: 持续无支持的情境下，疲劳可能上升。
branch_a.en: Fatigue may rise under sustained unsupported demands.

branch_b.zh: 有自主性和支持时，同等互动也可能带来满足。
branch_b.en: With autonomy and support, similar interaction may be satisfying.

test.zh: 分测负担、疲劳、动机；若数据只支持动机改变，不称为固定能量耗尽。
test.en: Measure demands, fatigue and motivation separately; motivational change alone is not fixed-energy depletion.

mechanism.zh: 对同类刺激重复暴露，反应可能随适应速度而改变。
mechanism.en: Repeated exposure to similar stimuli may change responses at different adaptation rates.

branch_a.zh: 习惯化时，需要更强刺激才出现相同即时反应。
branch_a.en: Under habituation, stronger stimuli may be needed for the same immediate response.

branch_b.zh: 敏化、学习或更换语境时，反应可能增强而无需升级。
branch_b.en: Sensitization, learning or changed context may increase responses without escalation.

test.zh: 追踪同一人重复暴露曲线；稳定或增强的反应反驳普遍习惯化版本。
test.en: Follow within-person exposure curves; stable or increasing responses refute universal habituation.

mechanism.zh: 比较群体改变，会改变同一客观表现的相对位置。
mechanism.en: Changing reference groups changes the rank of the same objective performance.

branch_a.zh: 更广且更优秀的参照群体可能降低自我评价。
branch_a.en: Broader high-performing groups may lower self-evaluation.

branch_b.zh: 若比较被解释为可学习目标，也可能激发动机。
branch_b.en: Comparison construed as an attainable learning target may motivate.

test.zh: 保持表现不变，改变可见参照；若评价不随参照变化，缩小比较机制适用范围。
test.en: Hold performance fixed and vary references; unchanged evaluation narrows the mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 生活条件改善后，满意度取决于实际充分性及期望调整。
mechanism.en: After material improvement, satisfaction depends on sufficiency and changing aspirations.

branch_a.zh: 需要得到满足且期望稳定时，满意度可以持续提高。
branch_a.en: Meeting needs with stable aspirations can sustain satisfaction gains.

branch_b.zh: 若期望同步上升，主观改善可能较小。
branch_b.en: Concurrently rising aspirations may reduce perceived gains.

test.zh: 纵向分测生活条件和期望；持续改善反驳所有收益必被适应吞没的说法。
test.en: Measure conditions and aspirations longitudinally; durable gains refute inevitable complete adaptation.

mechanism.zh: 质量可比的服务中，边际成本下降为降价创造空间。
mechanism.en: Lower marginal costs create room for lower prices at comparable quality.

branch_a.zh: 竞争和替代充分时，部分节省可能传给买方。
branch_a.en: Competition and substitutes may pass some savings to buyers.

branch_b.zh: 定价权、固定成本或稀缺渠道可能使价格保持不变。
branch_b.en: Market power, fixed costs or scarce channels may keep prices unchanged.

test.zh: 比较成本变化与实际成交价；无价格传导否定自动降价命题。
test.en: Compare costs with realized prices; no pass-through rejects automatic price reduction.

mechanism.zh: 若表面完成度可低成本模仿，它与真实能力的关联可能减弱。
mechanism.en: Cheap imitation of polish may weaken its association with underlying competence.

branch_a.zh: 仅凭外观筛选时，误判可能增加。
branch_a.en: Screening by appearance alone may produce more errors.

branch_b.zh: 若所有产出真实质量也同步提高，信号未必失效。
branch_b.en: If genuine quality rises too, signal informativeness may persist.

test.zh: 盲测外观与独立质量相关性；相关性未下降时不能宣布信号崩溃。
test.en: Test polish against independent quality; stable correlation does not support signal collapse.

mechanism.zh: 在风险和收益不变时，更高检查成本可能减少主动核验。
mechanism.en: At fixed stakes and benefits, higher checking costs may reduce verification.

branch_a.zh: 核验困难时，更多信息可能被直接接受或放弃。
branch_a.en: Difficult checking may lead to uncritical acceptance or abandonment.

branch_b.zh: 高风险、强责任或良好工具可能维持核验。
branch_b.en: High stakes, responsibility or good tools may sustain checking.

test.zh: 比较同风险任务的检查摩擦；若检查率不变，成本解释不足。
test.en: Vary checking friction at equal stakes; unchanged checking weakens the cost explanation.

mechanism.zh: 可检查的历史记录使他人能够更新对来源的可靠性预期。
mechanism.en: Checkable histories allow reliability expectations about sources to update.

branch_a.zh: 记录准确且纠错及时，信誉可能积累。
branch_a.en: Accurate records and timely corrections may build reputation.

branch_b.zh: 追溯揭露持续错误时，信誉可能下降。
branch_b.en: Traceability revealing persistent errors may reduce reputation.

test.zh: 比较公开记录前后的信任与准确判断；若只提高名气而非校准，不支持可靠信任路径。
test.en: Compare trust and accuracy judgments before and after disclosure; fame without calibration does not support warranted trust.

mechanism.zh: 新增可得回应可能改变期望关系与实际关系的主观差距。
mechanism.en: Additional available responses may change the perceived gap between desired and actual relationships.

branch_a.zh: 补充原本缺少的交流时，孤独可能减轻。
branch_a.en: Supplementing missing interaction may reduce loneliness.

branch_b.zh: 若替代实际支持或抬高期待，孤独可能不变或增加。
branch_b.en: Displacing support or raising expectations may leave loneliness unchanged or higher.

test.zh: 优先随机分配可得性并追踪基线；仅用户间相关不能排除反向因果。
test.en: Prefer randomized availability with baseline follow-up; between-user correlation cannot exclude reverse causation.

mechanism.zh: 彼此能提出需求的关系，需要一定协商但也允许共同修复。
mechanism.en: Reciprocal relationships involve negotiation and can support joint repair.

branch_a.zh: 可处理的分歧可能加深理解。
branch_a.en: Manageable disagreement may deepen understanding.

branch_b.zh: 持续伤害或不对等压力不会因被称作摩擦而有益。
branch_b.en: Persistent harm or unequal pressure is not beneficial merely because it is called friction.

test.zh: 测量修复质量和双方福祉；有摩擦无互惠收益时，否定摩擦必有价值的版本。
test.en: Measure repair and both parties' welfare; friction without reciprocal benefit rejects its automatic value.

mechanism.zh: 工具接管步骤后，独立练习的频率可能下降。
mechanism.en: Tool takeover may reduce independent practice.

branch_a.zh: 缺少主动尝试和反馈时，独立熟练度可能下降。
branch_a.en: Without active attempts and feedback, unaided proficiency may fall.

branch_b.zh: 若释放时间用于更难练习，能力可能提高。
branch_b.en: Time redirected to harder practice may improve skill.

test.zh: 采用延迟无工具测验；只看即时完成度不能确认学习或退化。
test.en: Use delayed unaided tests; immediate completion cannot establish learning or decline.

mechanism.zh: 任务标准更新时，准确反馈可帮助识别旧技能与新要求的差距。
mechanism.en: As standards change, accurate feedback can reveal gaps in existing skills.

branch_a.zh: 反馈及时且可行动时，适应速度可能提高。
branch_a.en: Timely actionable feedback may accelerate adaptation.

branch_b.zh: 反馈过时或不可理解时，练习可能巩固错误。
branch_b.en: Outdated or unintelligible feedback may reinforce errors.

test.zh: 测量新任务迁移而非练习题分数；迁移不改善削弱适应路径。
test.en: Measure transfer to new tasks; absent transfer weakens the adaptation path.

mechanism.zh: 基准能力提高后，只有流程与维护条件接通才能转成实际服务。
mechanism.en: Benchmark improvements require workflow and maintenance conditions to become services.

branch_a.zh: 成熟部署可把能力提升转成稳定任务收益。
branch_a.en: Ready deployment may turn capability into reliable task gains.

branch_b.zh: 缺少数据、维护或验收时，收益可能停留在演示。
branch_b.en: Missing data, maintenance or acceptance may confine gains to demonstrations.

test.zh: 对照基准与线上任务结果；两者脱节反驳能力直接等于收益。
test.en: Compare benchmarks and operational outcomes; divergence rejects direct equivalence.

mechanism.zh: 同等错误概率下，失败后果不同会产生不同预期损失。
mechanism.en: Equal error probabilities can produce different expected losses when consequences differ.

branch_a.zh: 低损失可回退任务可能适合更广自动化。
branch_a.en: Low-loss reversible tasks may permit broader automation.

branch_b.zh: 少量相关或严重错误可能主导总损失。
branch_b.en: Rare correlated or severe errors may dominate total loss.

test.zh: 同时记录频率、尾部与相关性；仅平均准确率不能支持可接受风险结论。
test.en: Record frequency, tails and correlation; average accuracy alone cannot establish acceptable risk.

mechanism.zh: 单份生成便宜后，使用量、核验和集成需求也可能增加。
mechanism.en: Cheaper generation may increase volume, verification and integration needs.

branch_a.zh: 需求固定且配套成本受控时，总成本下降。
branch_a.en: Fixed demand and controlled ancillary costs can lower total cost.

branch_b.zh: 用途扩张或纠错增加时，总成本可能上升。
branch_b.en: Expanded use or repair may raise total cost.

test.zh: 按固定质量和期限做全成本对照；总成本未降即推翻单价决定论。
test.en: Compare full costs at fixed quality and horizon; unchanged totals reject unit-price determinism.

mechanism.zh: 每任务耗能降低改变使用成本，但总资源消耗还取决于任务量。
mechanism.en: Lower energy per task changes costs, while total use also depends on task volume.

branch_a.zh: 任务量增长较小时，总耗能下降。
branch_a.en: Modest volume growth may reduce total energy use.

branch_b.zh: 增长超过效率收益时，总耗能上升。
branch_b.en: Growth exceeding efficiency gains raises total use.

test.zh: 分解每任务消耗与任务量；不要只用其中一项推断总量。
test.en: Decompose intensity and volume; neither alone determines totals.

mechanism.zh: 行动权限与责任归属不一致时，承担后果者可能无法改变行动。
mechanism.en: Misaligned authority and responsibility can leave cost bearers unable to change actions.

branch_a.zh: 权责配套可支持及时纠正。
branch_a.en: Matched authority and responsibility may support correction.

branch_b.zh: 无控制权的签字可能只是转移负担。
branch_b.en: Sign-off without control may merely shift burdens.

test.zh: 检查停止权是否实际行使；责任文本增加但纠错不变，削弱监督改善解释。
test.en: Examine actual stopping authority; more liability text without correction weakens the oversight claim.

mechanism.zh: 替代服务可用，只有迁移成本可承受时才形成真实退出选择。
mechanism.en: Available substitutes become real exit options only when switching is feasible.

branch_a.zh: 迁移低成本时，用户可以选择并约束服务方。
branch_a.en: Cheap migration may enable choice and discipline providers.

branch_b.zh: 历史数据和流程难迁时，多家供应也可能无效。
branch_b.en: Hard-to-move histories and workflows can neutralize nominal alternatives.

test.zh: 实际完成迁移试验；供应者数量增加却迁移失败，不支持有效竞争路径。
test.en: Test actual migration; more suppliers with failed switching do not establish effective competition.

mechanism.zh: 同一岗位的不同任务可能分别受到替代和互补作用。
mechanism.en: Different tasks in one job may face substitution and complementarity.

branch_a.zh: 互补任务需求扩大时，岗位可能重组并保留。
branch_a.en: Growing complementary demand may preserve a restructured job.

branch_b.zh: 替代覆盖主要价值且无新任务时，岗位可能缩减。
branch_b.en: Substitution of core tasks without new work may shrink employment.

test.zh: 做任务时间与收入分解；岗位名称不变不能证明任务未改变。
test.en: Decompose task time and income; unchanged job titles do not establish unchanged work.

mechanism.zh: 任务产值变化能否变成劳动报酬，取决于议价和外部选择。
mechanism.en: Whether task value becomes pay depends on bargaining and outside options.

branch_a.zh: 议价增强时，劳动者可能分享更多收益。
branch_a.en: Stronger bargaining may increase workers' shares.

branch_b.zh: 报酬被固定或单方定价时，产值提升未必加薪。
branch_b.en: Fixed pay or unilateral pricing may prevent wage gains.

test.zh: 比较相近生产率变化下不同谈判条件；若收益份额无差异，议价解释受限。
test.en: Compare similar productivity changes under different bargaining conditions; equal shares limit this explanation.

mechanism.zh: 监督对象增加时，决策权决定人能否限制负荷或停止流程。
mechanism.en: With more supervised tasks, decision rights determine whether reviewers can limit load or stop processes.

branch_a.zh: 有调度权的监督者可调整负荷。
branch_a.en: Reviewers with scheduling authority may manage load.

branch_b.zh: 只有责任没有调度权时，审核可能形式化。
branch_b.en: Responsibility without scheduling power may make review nominal.

test.zh: 观察单件审核时间与实质纠错；签字率上升不等于监督增强。
test.en: Observe review time and substantive corrections; more signatures do not establish stronger oversight.

mechanism.zh: 技术提高资产收益时，初始所有权结构影响受益分布。
mechanism.en: When technology raises asset returns, initial ownership shapes benefit distribution.

branch_a.zh: 所有权集中且无分享机制时，收益可能集中。
branch_a.en: Concentrated ownership without sharing may concentrate gains.

branch_b.zh: 广泛持有或公共分配可使收益更分散。
branch_b.en: Broad ownership or public distribution may spread gains.

test.zh: 追踪税前税后及资产收益；总利润上升不能确认谁受益。
test.en: Track pre- and post-distribution returns; aggregate profit growth does not identify beneficiaries.

mechanism.zh: 高进入壁垒会限制新竞争者对既有集中结构的挑战。
mechanism.en: Entry barriers can limit challenges to concentrated incumbents.

branch_a.zh: 规模、渠道和许可强化时，集中可能持续。
branch_a.en: Reinforced scale, channels and licensing may sustain concentration.

branch_b.zh: 开放标准或需求分化可能支持新进入者。
branch_b.en: Open standards or differentiated demand may enable entry.

test.zh: 先定义市场，再看进入退出与份额；高集中本身不能证明不可竞争。
test.en: Define the market and track entry, exit and shares; concentration alone does not establish noncontestability.

mechanism.zh: 推荐目标影响哪些选择显著，从而改变用户实际选择环境。
mechanism.en: Recommendation objectives shape salient options and the choice environment.

branch_a.zh: 用户认可且可调整目标时，推荐可支持自主行动。
branch_a.en: Endorsed adjustable goals may support autonomous action.

branch_b.zh: 目标隐蔽且难调整时，便利可能伴随控制感下降。
branch_b.en: Hidden rigid objectives may trade convenience for lower experienced control.

test.zh: 区分实际选项、主观自主与满意度；满意上升不足以证明自主提高。
test.en: Separate options, autonomy and satisfaction; satisfaction alone does not establish autonomy.

mechanism.zh: 目标分歧出现后，有效纠正渠道可能把争议转成可协商调整。
mechanism.en: After goal divergence, effective remedies may turn conflict into negotiable revision.

branch_a.zh: 独立申诉可纠正部分错误和不合理安排。
branch_a.en: Independent appeal may correct errors and unreasonable arrangements.

branch_b.zh: 无实际权限的入口可能只增加等待与负担。
branch_b.en: Channels without authority may add delay and burden.

test.zh: 测量纠正率与耗时；有入口无实际改变，不支持有效救济分支。
test.en: Measure correction and delay; a channel without change does not support effective remedy.

mechanism.zh: 误导收益固定时，被发现与承担后果的可能性改变净激励。
mechanism.en: At fixed gains from deception, detection and consequences alter net incentives.

branch_a.zh: 可信执行使预期代价超过收益时，欺骗可能减少。
branch_a.en: Credible enforcement exceeding benefits may reduce deception.

branch_b.zh: 执行选择性强或收益更大时，欺骗可能持续并转移。
branch_b.en: Selective enforcement or larger gains may sustain or displace deception.

test.zh: 同时观察隐蔽行为和替代渠道；只看被查获数不能推断真实发生率。
test.en: Observe concealed behavior and alternate channels; detections alone do not measure incidence.

mechanism.zh: 低成本学习材料可能放松资源限制，但有效学习还需要其他投入。
mechanism.en: Cheaper learning materials may relax constraints while effective learning still requires other inputs.

branch_a.zh: 时间、设备和指导齐备时，弱势群体机会可能改善。
branch_a.en: With time, devices and guidance, disadvantaged groups may gain opportunities.

branch_b.zh: 互补资源仍不平等时，优势家庭也可能获益更多。
branch_b.en: Unequal complements may yield larger gains to advantaged households.

test.zh: 按家庭背景追踪学习与机会；平均分数提高不证明流动性改善。
test.en: Follow learning and opportunities by background; higher mean scores do not establish mobility.

mechanism.zh: 可行选择扩大，让人有机会投入自己认可的活动。
mechanism.en: A wider feasible set can allow engagement in endorsed activities.

branch_a.zh: 选择与目标匹配并可实践时，意义感可能增强。
branch_a.en: Feasible goal-aligned action may strengthen meaning.

branch_b.zh: 选项过多但资源不足或目标冲突时，意义感未必变化。
branch_b.en: Many nominal options with scarce resources or conflicting goals may not help.

test.zh: 记录实际参与而非菜单数量；选择增加而可行性不变，不支持意义增益机制。
test.en: Measure realized participation rather than menu size; unchanged feasibility weakens the mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 有限注意面对扩大供给时，个性化改变筛选负担与内容集合。
mechanism.en: With limited attention and growing supply, personalization changes filtering effort and the content set.

branch_a.zh: 以用户认可目标匹配时，搜索成本下降并改善理解。
branch_a.en: Matching endorsed goals can reduce search cost and improve comprehension.

branch_b.zh: 只优化即时停留时，更多相关刺激也可能挤出长期目标。
branch_b.en: Optimizing immediate dwell time may displace longer-term goals.

test.zh: 比较相同供给下不同目标的推荐；若目标变化无行为差异，调节机制受限。
test.en: Compare objectives at equal supply; no behavioral difference limits the moderation claim.

mechanism.zh: 适应削弱即时反应，而可见性继续奖励该反应时，升级激励增强。
mechanism.en: Adaptation weakens immediate responses while visibility rewards them, increasing incentives to intensify stimuli.

branch_a.zh: 可见性竞争可能形成共同升级。
branch_a.en: Exposure competition may produce collective escalation.

branch_b.zh: 若评价转向持续满意或受众回避，升级可能失去收益。
branch_b.en: Durable satisfaction metrics or audience avoidance may remove escalation gains.

test.zh: 跟踪规则变化前后刺激强度与长期满意；未出现收益排序则不套用囚徒困境。
test.en: Track intensity and long-term satisfaction around rule changes; reject the dilemma model if payoff ordering fails.

mechanism.zh: 模仿降低形式信号区分度时，可追溯证据提供另一判断依据。
mechanism.en: When imitation weakens formal signals, traceable evidence offers an alternative basis.

branch_a.zh: 可靠追溯可能维持有区分的信任。
branch_a.en: Reliable provenance may preserve differentiated trust.

branch_b.zh: 来源记录可伪造或形成循环引用时，外观可信度仍可能误导。
branch_b.en: Forged or circular records may preserve misleading credibility.

test.zh: 测试真实与伪造证据识别；只有标签效果而无准确性提升，不支持核验收益。
test.en: Test authentic and forged evidence; label effects without accuracy gains do not support verification benefits.

mechanism.zh: 成本下降提高任务替代，同时价格传导可能扩大任务需求。
mechanism.en: Lower costs enable substitution while price pass-through may expand demand.

branch_a.zh: 需求弹性足够大时，扩量可能抵消部分人工需求减少。
branch_a.en: Sufficient demand elasticity may offset part of labor displacement.

branch_b.zh: 需求饱和或剩余人工含量很低时，劳动需求仍下降。
branch_b.en: Saturated demand or very low remaining labor content can reduce labor demand.

test.zh: 测量价格、总任务量与每任务人工；只看采用率不能分辨结果。
test.en: Measure price, volume and labor per task; adoption rates alone cannot distinguish outcomes.

mechanism.zh: 能力提高与劳动互补创造新增产出，议价决定部分分配。
mechanism.en: Capability and labor complementarity create output; bargaining shapes its allocation.

branch_a.zh: 劳动者拥有可行替代与谈判权时，报酬可能提高。
branch_a.en: Feasible alternatives and bargaining may raise pay.

branch_b.zh: 组织占有全部新增收益时，报酬可以不变。
branch_b.en: If organizations retain gains, pay may remain unchanged.

test.zh: 比较相似任务与资本投入下收益份额；生产率提高不单独验证工资机制。
test.en: Compare shares at similar tasks and capital inputs; productivity alone does not verify a wage mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 工具省下执行时间后，练习投入与反馈决定是否形成技能。
mechanism.en: After tools save execution time, practice and feedback shape skill formation.

branch_a.zh: 时间转为主动练习且反馈可靠时，迁移能力可提高。
branch_a.en: Active practice with reliable feedback may improve transfer.

branch_b.zh: 直接交付答案而不练习时，即时表现可提高但学习不变。
branch_b.en: Direct answers without practice may improve completion without learning.

test.zh: 延迟无工具迁移测验；只有辅助成绩提升支持表现，不支持学习。
test.en: Use delayed unaided transfer tests; assisted gains support performance, not learning.

mechanism.zh: 新增互动的影响由既有现实支持和原有孤独共同限定。
mechanism.en: Existing offline support and baseline loneliness condition added interaction.

branch_a.zh: 帮助求助和维系现实网络时，可能减少孤独。
branch_a.en: Facilitating help-seeking and existing ties may reduce loneliness.

branch_b.zh: 挤出原本有效支持时，长期孤独可能增加。
branch_b.en: Displacing effective support may increase longer-term loneliness.

test.zh: 追踪实际支持、基线和使用分配；控制基线后差异消失，削弱直接使用因果说。
test.en: Track support, baseline and assigned use; disappearing differences weaken direct causal attribution.

mechanism.zh: 持续低摩擦互动可能改变对其他关系的期望，但偏好可塑性有差异。
mechanism.en: Persistent low-friction interaction may change expectations, with heterogeneous preference plasticity.

branch_a.zh: 若期待迁移到人际关系，正常协商可能更难接受。
branch_a.en: Transferred expectations may reduce tolerance for ordinary negotiation.

branch_b.zh: 若被理解为练习或独立服务，人际期待可能不变或改善。
branch_b.en: Framing as practice or a separate service may leave expectations unchanged or improved.

test.zh: 测量跨情境迁移；仅对服务满意不能验证对真人耐心下降。
test.en: Measure cross-context transfer; service satisfaction alone does not establish less patience with people.

mechanism.zh: 明确目标只有在存在可行行动时，才可能降低部分不确定焦虑。
mechanism.en: Clear goals may reduce some uncertainty-related anxiety when feasible action exists.

branch_a.zh: 行动可达且反馈清楚时，主观控制感可能增强。
branch_a.en: Accessible action and clear feedback may improve perceived control.

branch_b.zh: 缺少资源或目标无法实现时，清晰也可能揭示困难。
branch_b.en: Without resources, clarity may instead expose difficulty.

test.zh: 同时测量目标、资源和焦虑；清晰无改善时检查可行性而非责备个人。
test.en: Measure goals, resources and anxiety; inspect feasibility rather than blame individuals when clarity fails to help.

mechanism.zh: 目标分歧在退出成本高时可能持续，因为用户难以更换服务。
mechanism.en: Goal divergence may persist under high exit costs because users cannot readily switch.

branch_a.zh: 缺少纠正或替代时，不认可的优化可能继续。
branch_a.en: Without remedy or alternatives, unendorsed optimization may persist.

branch_b.zh: 用户可调整目标或获得实际救济时，分歧可被缓解。
branch_b.en: Adjustable objectives or effective remedies may reduce divergence.

test.zh: 比较退出成本变化后的规则反应；用户留存高不能单独解释为满意。
test.en: Compare provider responses to changed exit costs; high retention alone does not establish satisfaction.

mechanism.zh: 数据可导出且替代服务可用，才可能降低实际迁移损失。
mechanism.en: Exportable usable data and viable alternatives can reduce migration losses.

branch_a.zh: 兼容历史与工作流时，退出成本下降。
branch_a.en: Compatible histories and workflows may lower exit costs.

branch_b.zh: 导出格式不可用或关系无法迁移时，形式可携无效。
branch_b.en: Unusable formats or immovable relationships may defeat nominal portability.

test.zh: 实际迁移任务的时间与成功率是关键；下载按钮数量不是结果。
test.en: Measure migration time and success; download-button counts are not outcomes.

mechanism.zh: 系统高平均可靠性可能促使组织扩大监督跨度并保留个人责任。
mechanism.en: High average reliability may encourage broader oversight loads while retaining individual responsibility.

branch_a.zh: 异常稀少且可及时发现时，监督可能有效。
branch_a.en: Rare detectable exceptions may permit effective review.

branch_b.zh: 异常集中且审核时间不足时，责任可能脱离控制。
branch_b.en: Clustered exceptions and insufficient review time may separate liability from control.

test.zh: 测量异常时的纠错而非平时签字；尾部失败增多会否定有效监督分支。
test.en: Measure correction during exceptions, not routine signatures; increasing tail failures weaken effective oversight.

mechanism.zh: 硬件集中带来规模优势时，互操作性影响其他主体接入收益。
mechanism.en: When concentrated hardware creates scale advantages, interoperability affects access to gains.

branch_a.zh: 标准兼容与公平接入可扩散部分收益。
branch_a.en: Compatible standards and fair access may spread benefits.

branch_b.zh: 专有接口和迁移障碍可能使收益集中。
branch_b.en: Proprietary interfaces and migration barriers may concentrate gains.

test.zh: 比较接入成本和实际收益分布；接口开放但成本未变，不能确认普惠。
test.en: Compare access costs and benefit distributions; nominal openness without lower barriers does not establish inclusion.

mechanism.zh: 单位成本降低引发任务需求增长，总资源取决于单位消耗与规模乘积。
mechanism.en: Lower unit costs can expand demand; total resources depend on intensity times volume.

branch_a.zh: 需求增长较低时，资源节省保留。
branch_a.en: Modest demand growth preserves savings.

branch_b.zh: 新增用途与高弹性时，节省可能被部分或全部抵消。
branch_b.en: New uses and elastic demand may partly or fully offset savings.

test.zh: 分别估计需求反应与效率；没有规模扩张时，不支持反弹解释。
test.en: Estimate demand response and efficiency separately; no expansion weakens rebound attribution.

mechanism.zh: 教育资源便宜后，照护负担仍可能限制有效学习时间。
mechanism.en: Cheaper educational resources may leave care obligations constraining study time.

branch_a.zh: 配套照护和连续时间使更多人能完成学习。
branch_a.en: Care support and uninterrupted time may enable completion.

branch_b.zh: 只提供课程而不缓解负担，机会差距可能持续。
branch_b.en: Courses alone may leave opportunity gaps intact.

test.zh: 按照护负担比较完成与迁移；注册增长不等于学习机会兑现。
test.en: Compare completion and transfer by care load; enrollment growth is not realized opportunity.

mechanism.zh: 数据代表性与本地文化适配共同影响群体表现及对结果的认可。
mechanism.en: Data representation and local cultural fit affect group performance and legitimacy judgments.

branch_a.zh: 覆盖不足得到修正且程序可解释时，差异可能缩小。
branch_a.en: Better coverage and explainable procedures may reduce disparities.

branch_b.zh: 单一指标改善仍可能违背重要本地价值。
branch_b.en: Improvement on one metric may still conflict with local values.

test.zh: 分语言、群体与价值维度测量；平均准确率上升不证明公平或认可。
test.en: Measure by language, group and value; mean accuracy does not establish fairness or legitimacy.

mechanism.zh: 可追溯记录让审计有材料，独立性与执行决定发现能否转成纠正。
mechanism.en: Traceable records enable audits; independence and enforcement shape correction.

branch_a.zh: 专业独立审计配合执行，可减少部分重复错误。
branch_a.en: Competent independent audits with enforcement may reduce repeated failures.

branch_b.zh: 审计无权或信息选择性提供时，记录可能只是形式。
branch_b.en: Powerless audits or selective disclosure can make records ceremonial.

test.zh: 追踪发现到纠正链条；披露增多却重复错误不降，削弱治理有效性。
test.en: Trace findings through correction; more disclosures without fewer repeat failures weaken effectiveness claims.

mechanism.zh: 平台展示改变比较群体，可能进一步调整正常生活的期望。
mechanism.en: Platform exposure changes reference groups and may adjust aspirations about normal life.

branch_a.zh: 持续展示极端成功时，部分人可能提高不现实期望。
branch_a.en: Persistent exceptional success may raise unrealistic aspirations for some.

branch_b.zh: 展示多样路径和条件信息时，可能改善校准。
branch_b.en: Diverse paths and contextual information may improve calibration.

test.zh: 随机改变展示构成并测量期望；曝光变化无期望变化时，链条中断。
test.en: Vary exposure composition and measure aspirations; unchanged aspirations interrupt the chain.

mechanism.zh: 任务变化先于制度支持时，转型成本可能集中于受冲击群体。
mechanism.en: When task change precedes institutional support, transition costs may concentrate on exposed groups.

branch_a.zh: 保障及时可降低收入中断与被迫选择。
branch_a.en: Timely protection may reduce income interruption and forced choices.

branch_b.zh: 支持覆盖不足或迟到时，总体增长可伴随局部长期损失。
branch_b.en: Inadequate or delayed support may coexist with growth and persistent local losses.

test.zh: 按受影响群体追踪收入与保障时点；行业总增长不能否定个体损失。
test.en: Follow affected groups and support timing; industry growth does not refute individual losses.

mechanism.zh: 规模经济鼓励集中，集中却可能增加共同冲击暴露。
mechanism.en: Scale economies encourage concentration that may increase common-shock exposure.

branch_a.zh: 冗余和替代路径可牺牲部分成本优势换取恢复能力。
branch_a.en: Redundancy may exchange some cost advantage for recovery capacity.

branch_b.zh: 若备份高度相关或不可切换，名义冗余不增加韧性。
branch_b.en: Correlated or unusable backups may not improve resilience.

test.zh: 压力测试实际恢复时间；副本数量增加而恢复不变，不支持韧性收益。
test.en: Stress-test actual recovery; more copies without better recovery do not establish resilience.

mechanism.zh: 供给扩张经个性化筛选进入有限注意，推荐目标决定筛选偏向。
mechanism.en: Expanded supply enters limited attention through personalization shaped by recommendation objectives.

branch_a.zh: 优化可验证学习与自主目标时，丰裕可转成有效知识。
branch_a.en: Optimizing verifiable learning and endorsed goals can turn abundance into useful knowledge.

branch_b.zh: 优化即时反应且忽视后续成本时，丰裕可能变成干扰。
branch_b.en: Immediate-reaction optimization ignoring downstream costs may turn abundance into distraction.

test.zh: 在供给与预算可比时干预推荐目标，测延迟学习；无目标差异效应则核心调节不成立。
test.en: Intervene on objectives at comparable supply and budgets; no delayed-learning differences weaken the moderation.

mechanism.zh: 适应改变反应，可见性影响收入，使创作者对他人策略作出回应。
mechanism.en: Adaptation changes reactions; visibility affects revenue, linking producers' choices to rivals.

branch_a.zh: 收益满足囚徒困境排序时，双方升级可成为低福利均衡。
branch_a.en: Prisoner's-dilemma payoffs can make mutual escalation a low-welfare equilibrium.

branch_b.zh: 长期收入奖励克制或规则改变收益时，该均衡可消失。
branch_b.en: Long-term rewards for restraint or changed rules may remove that equilibrium.

test.zh: 估计四种策略组合收益；不满足排序便不能声称存在该均衡。
test.en: Estimate payoffs for all four strategy pairs; failed ordering rejects this equilibrium claim.

mechanism.zh: 系统能力改变待审任务，核验能力与监督负荷决定责任能否落实。
mechanism.en: System capability changes review tasks; verification capacity and load determine whether responsibility is actionable.

branch_a.zh: 审核者能识错、有时间且责任配套停止权时，错误可被拦截。
branch_a.en: Competent reviewers with time and stopping authority may intercept errors.

branch_b.zh: 名义责任增长而能力与时间不足时，审核可能成为橡皮图章。
branch_b.en: Rising liability without capacity or time may create rubber-stamping.

test.zh: 设计带已知错误的盲审，测检出与停止；签字完整但漏错高否定实质审核。
test.en: Use blinded seeded-error reviews; complete signatures with high misses reject substantive oversight.

title.zh: 自动化之后的劳动结果

mechanism.zh: 低成本提高替代，需求扩张改变任务总量，议价决定剩余收益分配。
mechanism.en: Cheap substitution changes labor content; demand changes volume; bargaining allocates remaining gains.

branch_a.zh: 高需求与有力议价可支持部分劳动者收入改善。
branch_a.en: Strong demand and bargaining may improve some workers' incomes.

branch_b.zh: 低需求与弱议价可能使产出增长仍伴随收入下降。
branch_b.en: Weak demand and bargaining may allow output growth alongside income loss.

test.zh: 联合测量人工/任务、任务量与工资份额；缺一项不作确定就业预测。
test.en: Measure labor per task, volume and wage shares; missing components preclude a definite employment forecast.

title.zh: 教育丰裕怎样形成能力

mechanism.zh: 低成本辅助只有经可获得的练习时间、反馈与学习条件，才形成持久能力。
mechanism.en: Cheap assistance supports durable skill through accessible practice, feedback and learning conditions.

branch_a.zh: 互补条件普及时，弱势学习者可能获得更大提升。
branch_a.en: Widely available complements may yield greater gains for disadvantaged learners.

branch_b.zh: 时间与指导继续集中时，优势群体可能拉大领先。
branch_b.en: Concentrated time and guidance may widen existing advantages.

test.zh: 按基线资源分层，做延迟迁移测验；即时平均成绩不能区分公平分支。
test.en: Stratify by initial resources and test delayed transfer; immediate means cannot distinguish equity outcomes.

title.en: The dual structure of companionship services

mechanism.zh: 持续回应接入关系网络，同时由服务目标与亲密数据使用塑造互动。
mechanism.en: Persistent responses enter support networks while objectives and intimate-data use shape interaction.

branch_a.zh: 以用户认可目标运行并保护数据时，可补充支持。
branch_a.en: Endorsed objectives and protected data may support existing relationships.

branch_b.zh: 若以依赖和延长使用为目标，支持收益可能伴随控制与暴露成本。
branch_b.en: Objectives favoring dependence and prolonged use may add control and exposure costs.

test.zh: 独立测量支持、退出、数据使用与福祉；高满意不能抹去其他成本。
test.en: Measure support, exit, data use and welfare separately; satisfaction cannot erase other costs.

mechanism.zh: 模仿能力扩张后，证据记录、独立审计和执行共同决定核验是否有效。
mechanism.en: As imitation expands, evidence, independent auditing and enforcement jointly shape verification.

branch_a.zh: 链条完整可把可信判断从外观转向可检查过程。
branch_a.en: A functioning chain may shift trust from appearance to inspectable processes.

branch_b.zh: 某一环节被控制或无法执行时，认证可能成为新误导信号。
branch_b.en: Captured or unenforceable links may turn certification into a misleading signal.

test.zh: 以独立已知真值测认证误差与纠正；标签采用率不能证明可信性提升。
test.en: Test certification against independently known truth and corrections; adoption does not establish credibility.

mechanism.zh: 优化目标与用户利益分歧，在高退出成本下需靠真实申诉或目标协商调整。
mechanism.en: Divergent objectives under costly exit require effective appeal or renegotiation.

branch_a.zh: 用户能纠正、撤回与更换时，委托可保持可控。
branch_a.en: Correction, revocation and switching can keep delegation controllable.

branch_b.zh: 退出和申诉都无效时，名义同意可能不能反映认可。
branch_b.en: Ineffective exit and appeal may make nominal consent a poor sign of endorsement.

test.zh: 实测撤回和纠正，不用勾选率代替；通道真实有效时锁定悲观分支受限。
test.en: Test revocation and correction rather than checkbox rates; effective channels limit the pessimistic lock-in branch.

mechanism.zh: 能源效率、硬件扩张和资源总量共同决定负荷，内部化规则影响采用激励。
mechanism.en: Efficiency, hardware growth and total resources shape loads; internalization rules alter incentives.

branch_a.zh: 资源约束被计入决策且替代有效时，扩张可能保持较低外部损失。
branch_a.en: Accounting for constraints with effective alternatives may limit external harms.

branch_b.zh: 只看单位效率且外部成本未计入时，总损失可能增长。
branch_b.en: Unit-efficiency focus with unpriced external costs may increase aggregate harm.

test.zh: 生命周期与地区数据核算，比较规则改变；只算运营电费不能验证生态结论。
test.en: Use lifecycle and regional accounting around rule changes; operating electricity bills alone do not establish ecological outcomes.

mechanism.zh: 排名与参照影响期望，但社会保障改变失去位置的实际代价。
mechanism.en: Rank and references shape aspirations, while protection changes the actual cost of losing position.

branch_a.zh: 基本生活不依赖短期排名时，部分竞争压力可能降低。
branch_a.en: When basic security is less rank-dependent, some competitive pressure may decline.

branch_b.zh: 地位认同仍高度集中时，物质安全也未必消除比较焦虑。
branch_b.en: Concentrated status identities may sustain anxiety despite material security.

test.zh: 分测生计风险和地位焦虑；保障只降低前者时，应分开两条机制。
test.en: Separate livelihood and status anxiety; protection affecting only the former requires distinct mechanisms.

mechanism.zh: 快速部署与制度调整不同步时，受影响者参与可能改变转型安排。
mechanism.en: When deployment outpaces institutional change, participation may alter transition arrangements.

branch_a.zh: 及时参与可使成本更早被识别并分担。
branch_a.en: Timely participation may identify and share costs earlier.

branch_b.zh: 参与无实际权力或调整迟到时，成本仍可能单方承担。
branch_b.en: Powerless participation or delayed adjustment may leave costs unilateral.

test.zh: 记录参与对具体规则的影响；开会次数增加但安排不变，不支持参与机制。
test.en: Trace influence on rules; more meetings without changed arrangements do not support the mechanism.

mechanism.zh: 可行选择与未来可预期性影响目标实践，但价值多元使满意结果不唯一。
mechanism.en: Feasible choices and predictability shape goal pursuit, while plural values prevent a single satisfactory outcome.

branch_a.zh: 承认取舍且保留可行行动时，不确定中仍可能形成稳定意义。
branch_a.en: Acknowledged trade-offs and feasible action may sustain meaning amid uncertainty.

branch_b.zh: 以统一成功标准压缩选择时，预测更准确也未必改善意义。
branch_b.en: A single success standard may narrow choices so that better forecasts do not improve meaning.

test.zh: 结合纵向叙事与实际选择，不将意义折算成收入或使用时长；无改善则修订作用范围。
test.en: Combine longitudinal narratives and real choices, not income or usage substitutes; absent gains require scope revision.
